notes: Relay witness (Urdu -> Turkish). The Turkish Tefhîm team (İnsan Yayınları) included Ali Bulaç: its meal lines are ~73% identical to MEAL-BULAC over S1, S22, S87-114, so the two are not independent witnesses. 2 merged verse groups stored once as a..a_end. 2 host verse-number prefixes (e.g. "6, 7.", "(6-7)") removed from the text; the range is in a..a_end. Coverage incomplete (883/6236); re-run `fetch_meal.py fetch --sources MEAL-TEFHIM` then `build` to resume.
